content.title: How do I vote for American Idol? – ABC
content.text: Please enter your birthdate Please enter your birthdate Submit Skip to Main Content SUPPORT Request Technical SupportSubmit Programming Feedback There are three convenient ways to vote for your favorite American Idol finalists: On a supported browser at AmericanIdol.com/Vote By SMS text* Commenting on the pinned official voting post for the night on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok when voting is open Please note that voting registration on AmericanIdol.com/Vote is only available to viewers 16 years of age or older who are located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands. You must be at least 18 years old and located in the U.S. to vote on social media platforms. For more information about the latest season of American Idol, please visit ABC.com/Shows/American-Idol. To learn more about voting, check out our voting FAQs page. Social media vote terms are available at IdolVote.ABC.com/#socialvotingterms. To submit comments or suggestions for your favorite ABC shows, including American Idol, select the Programming Feedback Form button (located under the Help Center search bar). *Text voting is open to U.S. wireless carriers. Message and data rates may apply. SMS vote terms are available at idolmobileterms.votenow.tv. Please sign in to leave a comment. em:ph:li: Need more help? Notice of Right to Opt Out of Sale/SharingSome US states provide residents (or their authorized agents) with the right to opt out of “targeted advertising,” “selling,” or “sharing” of personal information, as defined by applicable laws. You can move the toggle to the left and click “Submit” to opt out of such activities occurring through this digital property. If you are logged in, we may be able to associate your choice with your account and apply it to data sharing occurring through this digital property (across your browsers and devices) as well as other digital properties of The Walt Disney Family of Companies. You can confirm the status of your choice or opt out or in by clicking “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” or “Your Privacy Choices” on each property. Manage Consent PreferencesSelling, Sharing, Targeted Advertising Selling, Sharing, Targeted Advertising If you are not logged in, your opt-out will be specific to this property and device or browser. For our other digital properties, to opt out, select “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” or “Your Privacy Choices” on each. If you clear your tracking history or use another browser or device, you’ll need to opt out again.You can also submit this opt-out form, which may enable us to apply your opt-out more broadly, for example, to stop data sharing in connection with advertising intended to reach you on platforms not operated by Disney (e.g., social media platforms). You may enable online, where available, a universal tool that automatically communicates your opt-out, such as Global Privacy Control (“GPC”), which we’ll process as if you had opted out through the toggle.Even if you opt out, you may continue to see advertising, including ads that may be based on personal information processed before you opted out.
